_definition: per cell (table, n): floor, distance of the independent-columns generator T1, measured paired standard deviation at the T1 level, and the smallest resolvable skill difference rho = (z_0.975 + z_0.80) sd_pair / (D_T1 - floor), measured and with the floor proxy
_scope: n <= 4000 per side; tables capped at 20000 rows; the generator is held fixed, so rho is a lower bound on the difference required when trained models are compared
